findings.explanation: The contract allows the scope of services to be extended without a change-order process, meaning you could be required to perform extra work without guaranteed additional pay.
findings.suggested_change: Initially, services will cover 3 products, as per the attached price sheets. Any extension or additional services must be agreed upon in a written change order detailing the additional fees and deliverables.

findings.quoted_text: Dragon may terminate this agreement without cause by giving sixty (60) days written notice to [PARTY_B].
findings.explanation: Only the client can end the contract without cause, and the agreement does not explicitly guarantee payment for all work completed or expenses incurred up to the termination date.
findings.suggested_change: Either party may terminate this agreement without cause by giving sixty (60) days written notice to the other party, and the Client shall pay the Contractor for all services rendered and expenses incurred through the effective date of termination.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, thank you for sending over the paperwork. I have a couple of minor suggestions before we proceed: - Regarding the relevant clause on product extensions, the agreement allows the scope to be extended without a change-order process, which could mean performing extra work without guaranteed pay. I propose updating this to: "Initially, services will cover 3 products, as per the attached price sheets. Any extension or additional services must be agreed upon in a written change order detailing the additional fees and deliverables." - Regarding the termination clause, only one party can end the contract without cause and payment for completed work is not explicitly guaranteed. I propose updating this to: "Either party may terminate this agreement without cause by giving sixty (60) days written notice to the other party, and the Client shall pay the Contractor for all services rendered and expenses incurred through the effective date of termination." Please let me know if these adjustments work for you. Best regards,
